inlines.v: PROS'ECUTOR, noun One who pursues or carries on any purpose, plan or business. 1. The person who institutes and carries on a criminal suit in a legal tribunal, or one who exhibits criminal charges against an offender. The attorney general is the prosecutor for the king or state.
